name: Order Picking App
author: Arture B.V.

sections.description:
Efficient order picking for your WooCommerce shop 🚀

As your webshop grows, so does the challenge of processing all orders accurately and on time. Manual order picking not only takes a lot of time but also often leads to mistakes and frustration for both you and your customers. The Orderpicking App solves this problem – fast, smart, and fully integrated with WooCommerce.

In just a few minutes you connect the plugin to your webshop. From that moment, you’ll work more efficiently: picking and packing orders up to 3x faster, with maximum accuracy. You save time, reduce errors, and boost customer satisfaction.

“Since we started using the Orderpicking App, we hardly make any mistakes anymore. At Deshop it saves us a huge amount of time and frustration.”

Fully customizable to your workflow

No webshop is the same – that’s why the Orderpicking App is fully customizable thanks to countless settings. Easily adapt the app to your own workflow and preferences. Whether you’re just starting out or processing hundreds of orders daily, the app scales with your business.

Key Features

  • Single and batch order picking → process one order or multiple at once
  • Barcode scanning → smartphone camera or Bluetooth scanner
  • Fully customizable → endless settings so the app works your way
  • Auto-complete orders → save valuable time
  • Lightning-fast support → our team responds quickly and thinks along with you

“We were live within an hour. At Bento it just worked right away, and we save hours of work every day!”

Start today – risk free

The Orderpicking App is not only powerful but also affordable: starting at just €14.95 per month. Best of all, you can try it free for 30 days – no commitments, no transaction fees. Don’t like it? Simply cancel within the trial period.
sections.installation:
1. Install our plugin.
  2. Activate our plugin
  3. Start your 30 days trial direct inside Woocommerce
  4. Install our app for IOS or Android
  5. Scan or enter your API key
  6. Yeh, start picking!
